# ATT&CK Navigator: TeamStarWolf Coverage Layers

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py from the layer files; edit the CATALOG in that script, not this page. -->

ATT&CK Navigator layers built on this library's data. Every ATT&CK layer (Enterprise, ICS and Mobile) is pinned to ATT&CK v19 and uses the ATT&CK v19.2 technique IDs and tactics, including Stealth and Defense Impairment in place of the retired Defense Evasion; `scripts/validate_navigator.py` checks every technique ID and tactic against the library's profile data in CI. Provenance differs by section: the full-stack and analytic layers are generated from the [data files](https://github.com/TeamStarWolf/TeamStarWolf/tree/main/data/), the stage, vendor and library layers are hand-curated selections whose IDs and tactics are normalized to the current release by script, and the ATLAS and F3 layers are vendored from MITRE in their own Navigator domains.

## Fraud Matrix (MITRE F3)

The [MITRE Fight Fraud Framework](/FRAUD_FRAMEWORK_REFERENCE.md) matrix, published by MITRE's Center for Threat-Informed Defense (Apache-2.0) and vendored here with provenance metadata. F3 uses its own `f3-financial` domain and loads its data from the F3 STIX bundle named in the layer; some ATT&CK-specific overlays do not apply.

| Layer | Description | Techniques | Version | Load |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [F3 Matrix](https://github.com/TeamStarWolf/TeamStarWolf/blob/main/navigator/fraud/f3-matrix.json) | The full F3 fraud matrix: use with the [F3 reference](/FRAUD_FRAMEWORK_REFERENCE.md) and [datasets](https://github.com/TeamStarWolf/TeamStarWolf/tree/main/data/fraud/) | 123 | F3 v1.1 | [ Navigator](https://mitre-attack.github.io/attack-navigator/#layerURL=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TeamStarWolf/TeamStarWolf/main/navigator/fraud/f3-matrix.json) |

## Score Interpretation (Full Stack Layer)

| Score Range | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 20-32 | Many NIST 800-53 controls map to this technique (deep control coverage) |
| 10-19 | Moderate control coverage; most mature security programs address this technique |
| 1-9 | Few controls map here; may represent a capability gap worth prioritizing with compensating detection or design controls |

The score counts mapped NIST 800-53 controls (framework depth). It does not measure vendor coverage or what is deployed in any environment.
